output.rationale: The requirement specifies terminal blocks and connections for metal-clad switchgear. The product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an engineered-to-order (ETO) metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear lineup, which aligns with the specification for terminal blocks and connections in the Syracuse Airport Specification for Metal Clad Switchgear. This product is suitable for fulfilling the requirement.
